definition.def: The volume of something is the amount of it that there is.
examples: Senior officials will be discussing how the volume of sales might be reduced. [+ of]
...the sheer volume of traffic and accidents. [+ of]

definition.def: The volume of an object is the amount of space that it contains or occupies.
examples: They use PVA glue, mixed with the same volume of water.
When egg whites are beaten they can rise to seven or eight times their original volume.

definition.def: A volume is one book in a series of books.
examples: ...the first volume of his autobiography. [+ of]

definition.def: A volume is a collection of several issues of a magazine, for example all the issues for one year.
The volume of a radio, television, or sound system is the loudness of the sound it produces.
examples: He came to complain about the volume of the music. [+ of]

definition.def: If something such as an action speaks volumes about a person or thing, it gives you a lot of information about them.
examples: What you wear speaks volumes about you. [+ about]
